It’s hard to think of a shoe more versatile than the Chelsea boot. The style dates back to the Victorian era, but it wasn’t until the 1950s (when it became a go-to of England’s “Chelsea set”) that the boot earned its modern moniker. Todd’s elevated take on this classic is made in Portugal, and features suede uppers and crepe soles, and the iconic elastic side panels for a close, comfortable fit. And no Chelsea is complete without a pull tab at the back; ours is branded with the TS logo — just hook in a finger to help you pull these on as you head out the door. Wear them wherever, but they look especially chic with denim and workwear-inspired pants, cuffed at the ankle.

The Navy Blue Sandoval Oxford Chambray Camp Collar is a warm-weather custom shirt anchored by one of the most reliable colors in a well-built wardrobe. The open camp collar lends an effortless, relaxed character — equally at home worn open over a tee or buttoned to the top with tailored shorts. In navy blue, it pairs with nearly everything and earns its place as a seasonal go-to.
Premium Slub Cotton Chambray Fabric
Crafted from 100% slub cotton, this oxford chambray features a distinctive textured weave that creates a subtle heathered appearance. The natural slub variation in the yarn adds visual depth and character, ensuring no two shirts are exactly alike. Lightweight and breathable, it's built for warm days and the kind of wear that only gets better over time.
The Camp Collar Difference
The camp collar is cut to lie flat and open, eliminating the need for a tie and softening the overall silhouette without sacrificing structure. It's a detail that reads as intentional — relaxed but considered. Paired with the slub chambray in navy blue, the result is a shirt that feels as good as it looks from the first wear.
